meta.title: ASN-to-GRN Auto-Prefill: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Sign in as a Warehouse Executive on the Growth-plan tenant and verify that ASN-to-GRN Auto-Prefill is unavailable or refused.
Use ASN-to-GRN Auto-Prefill to prefill a GRN form from a linked ASN on the Growth tenant.
Repeat the same workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify that it is available and works.
Compare the capability outcome across Growth and Enterprise plans for the same user role.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a Warehouse Executive on the Growth-plan tenant and verify that ASN-to-GRN Auto-Prefill is unavailable or refused.; Use ASN-to-GRN Auto-Prefill to prefill a GRN form from a linked ASN on the Growth tenant.; Repeat the same workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify that it is available and works.; Compare the capability outcome across Growth and Enterprise plans for the same user role.

args.need: sign in as the Warehouse Executive, test ASN-to-GRN Auto-Prefill from a linked ASN on both the Growth and Enterprise tenants, and compare that Growth is unavailable or refused while Enterprise pre-fills the GRN form

steps.note: The catalog cannot access ASN/GRN workflows, authenticate as the Warehouse Executive, or compare plan tiers.
Confirm the resulting screen has no crash, server error, undefined values, or other rendering failure after the tester's comparison.
